chapter: Chicago, Virginia Ravens and the northern territory bands
title: Going to Toledo with Frank Terry's Chicago Nightingales
summary: Restless, he wrote to Frank Terry in Toledo and went as musical director, arranger and saxophonist, living across the street from Art Tatum.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: Then I had -- I was always itchy to go someplace so I wrote a fellow up in Toledo had a band called Frank Terry's Chicago Nightengales, I think it was. And I wrote them a letter and they sent for me and I went up there as his musical director and arranger and saxophone player. And this is where I met Art Tatum. Art Tatum was -- I was living on

City Park, right across the street from Art. And one night we played with the house band at the Recreation Ballroom there. And we would play five nights or six nights a week and on Monday we'd have off and we'd give a colored dance.
